name: Denzel Curry - HOT ONE Feat. TiaCorine & ASAP Ferg (Official Music Video)

description.ja: 『King of the Mischievous South Vol. 2』を代表する重厚なサザン・トラップ。デンゼル・カリー、TiaCorine、ASAP Fergの激しいマイクリレーが圧巻。
description.en: A blazing Southern trap anthem from Denzel Curry featuring raw, fast-paced verses alongside TiaCorine and ASAP Ferg.

name: Denzel Curry - BLACK FLAG FREESTYLE Feat. That Mexican OT (Official Music Video)

description.ja: テキサスの新星That Mexican OTを迎えたハードコアなフリースタイル。圧倒的な高速滑舌と重いベースラインがフロアを沸かせる。
description.en: Denzel Curry teams up with Texas sensation That Mexican OT for a hard-hitting freestyle bursting with rapid-fire flows.

name: Vince Staples - Shame On The Devil (Official Music Video)

description.ja: アルバム『Dark Times』に収録された、精神的な内省とロングビーチでの生い立ちを静かに紡ぐコンシャスな楽曲。シックなモノクロ映像が深みを与える。
description.en: An introspective track from Vince Staples' 'Dark Times' album, offering quiet reflection on faith, survival, and identity.

name: Doechii & JT - ALTER EGO (Official Music Video)

description.ja: DoechiiとJT（City Girls）によるハウス・ダンスビートとヒップホップが融合したセンセーショナルなクラブトラック。エネルギッシュでスタイリッシュな映像。
description.en: Doechii and JT combine house-infused dance beats with rapid rap verses in this vibrant, fashionable club hit.

description.ja: メンフィス出身のGloRillaによる2024年のバイラル・パーティーアンセム。週末の開放感とパワフルなラップスタイルが世界中のリスナーを魅了。
description.en: GloRilla's viral 2024 weekend anthem packed with her signature Memphis energy and unapologetic delivery.

name: GloRilla & Megan Thee Stallion - Wanna Be (Official Music Video)

description.ja: 女性ラップシーンのトップを走るGloRillaとMegan Thee Stallionによるタッグ曲。重厚なベースと大胆なリリックが炸裂するコラボ。
description.en: A fierce, chart-topping collaboration between GloRilla and Megan Thee Stallion driven by booming 808s and bold bars.

name: Sexyy Red - Get It Sexyy (Official Music Video)

description.ja: キャッチーなフレーズとストリートでの躍動的なダンスで話題をさらったSexyy Redの代表的パーティーソング。
description.en: Sexyy Red's viral hit that captivated summer 2024 with its infectious hook and playful, upbeat trap production.

name: Future, Metro Boomin, Travis Scott, Playboi Carti - Type Shit (Official Video)

description.ja: Future、Metro Boomin、Travis Scott、Playboi Cartiというトラップ界のオールスターが集結した壮大なアトランタ・トラップの到達点。
description.en: An all-star trap spectacle reuniting Future, Metro Boomin, Travis Scott, and Playboi Carti over dark, moody production.

name: Travis Scott - FE!N ft. Playboi Carti (Official Music Video)

description.ja: カメラが回転し続ける独特な撮影技法とレイジ・ビートが融合したトラヴィス・スコットとPlayboi Cartiの超エネルギー・アンセム。
description.en: A mesmerizing, continuously spinning visual paired with high-voltage rage beats featuring Playboi Carti.

description.ja: Tame Impalaのサンプルを用いたハードロックとトラップの融合。バイカーカルチャーを前面に出したDon ToliverのスタイリッシュなMV。
description.en: Sampling Tame Impala, Don Toliver fuses psych-rock sensibilities with heavy trap 808s and biker-aesthetic visuals.

name: Don Toliver - DEEP IN THE WATER (Official Music Video)

description.ja: メロディックで幻想的なサウンドに乗せてパートナーへの献身や内面を描いた、アルバム『Hardstone Psycho』のエモーショナルな一面を示す楽曲。
description.en: An atmospheric, melodic track where Don Toliver explores emotional depth and personal dedication over lush production.

name: Gunna - one of wun (Official Music Video)

description.ja: アルバムタイトル曲でもあるGunnaの滑らかなフローとラグジュアリーな雰囲気が詰まったアトランタ・トラップ。
description.en: The title track of Gunna's 2024 album showcasing his effortless flow and luxurious melodic style.

description.ja: 日常のコミュニケーションやストリートの熱気を軽快なビートで描写したガンナの2024年ヒットトラック。
description.en: A rhythmic, smooth trap single from Gunna highlighting his signature cadences and relaxed confidence.

name: ScHoolboy Q - THank god 4 me (Official Music Video)

description.ja: アルバム『BLUE LIPS』からのグラマラスかつ硬派なトラック。曲中で転調する展開とシネマティックなMVが高い評価を獲得。
description.en: ScHoolboy Q delivers a dynamic multi-part track from 'BLUE LIPS', shifting tones alongside striking cinematic visuals.

name: A$AP Rocky - HIGHJACK feat. Jessica Pratt (Official Music Video)

description.ja: フォークシンガーJessica Prattのボーカルをフィーチャーしたエイサップ・ロッキーの実験的サイケデリック・ヒップホップ。アート性の高いMVが秀逸。
description.en: A$AP Rocky blends psych-folk harmonies with sharp rap verses in this artistic, visionary music video featuring Jessica Pratt.

name: A$AP Rocky - Tailor Swif (Official Music Video)

description.ja: キエフで撮影されたシュールでカオスな映像が強烈なインパクトを与えるエイサップ・ロッキーのアップテンポ・トラック。
description.en: Shot in Kyiv, this wild and surreal visual accompanies A$AP Rocky's bouncy, energetic experimental single.

name: Megan Thee Stallion - HISS (Official Music Video)

description.ja: Billboard Hot 100で初登場1位を獲得したミーガン・ザ・スタリオンの鋭い言葉遣いと圧倒的カリスマ性が溢れる話題作。
description.en: Megan Thee Stallion's Billboard-topping single packed with razor-sharp bars and unmatched rap authority.

name: Megan Thee Stallion - MAMUSHI feat. Yuki Chiba (Official Music Video)

description.ja: 千葉雄喜（KOHH）を迎えて日本語と英語が交差するグローバル・ヒット曲。日本の映画やカルチャーへのオマージュが詰まったMV。
description.en: A monumental US-Japan cross-cultural hit featuring Yuki Chiba, blending Japanese and English lyrics with cinematic aesthetics.

description.ja: アルバム『Better Me Than You』の復帰作となる、ビッグ・ショーンの正確無比なテクニカル・ラップと躍動感あるビートが光るナンバー。
description.en: Big Sean showcases his tight, intricate flow and relentless lyricism over a brass-infused, upbeat trap beat.

description.ja: アルバム『2093』のフューチャリスティックな世界観を凝縮したYeatの人気トラック。重厚なシンセとレイヴ要素を含んだ独創的ビート。
description.en: Yeat brings his futuristic '2093' soundscape to life with pulsating synth rhythms and hypnotic cadences.

name: Key Glock - Let's Go (Official Music Video)

description.ja: メンフィス・トラップの旗手Key Glockによるエネルギッシュなアンセム。アクション映画のようなハードボイルドなMVが話題。
description.en: Memphis rap powerhouse Key Glock delivers a high-potency trap banger backed by cinematic, movie-like visuals.

name: JID - Sk8 feat. Ciara & EARTHGANG (Official Music Video)

description.ja: JIDがCiaraとEARTHGANGを迎えた2025年リリースのスケーターアンセム。軽快なビートに乗せた遊び心あふれるフロウが光る。
description.en: JID teams up with Ciara and EARTHGANG for a playful 2025 skater anthem with bouncy production and effortless flows from his album 'God Does Like Ugly'.

name: RIP SLYME - 楽園ベイベー (rakuen babe)

description.ja: 5人のMCとDJによる掛け合いフロウが弾ける、日本語ラップを代表するサマーアンセム。
description.en: A quintessential Japanese summer rap anthem, driven by the group's lively call-and-response flow.

name: 小沢健二 featuring スチャダラパー - 今夜はブギー・バック (nice vocal) [2024 Remaster]

description.ja: 渋谷系とヒップホップが交差した金字塔。スチャダラパーの軽快なフロウが今も色褪せない。
description.en: A landmark crossover between Shibuya-kei pop and hip-hop — Scha Dara Parr's breezy flow still feels timeless.

name: Creepy Nuts - Bling-Bang-Bang-Born × MASHLE Collaboration Music Video

description.ja: R-指定の超高速リリックとDJ松永のスクラッチが世界を席巻した、令和ヒップホップの代名詞。
description.en: R-Shitei's rapid-fire lyricism meets DJ Matsunaga's scratches in the track that took Japanese hip-hop global.

description.ja: Rachel と Mamiko のゆるくてキュートなラップが心地よい、肩の力が抜ける一曲。
description.en: Rachel and Mamiko's laid-back, cute-toned rap makes for an effortlessly cool, shoulder-relaxing listen.

description.ja: Madlibのダスティなループの上で、Freddie Gibbsが淡々と重みのあるリリックを刻む。
description.en: Freddie Gibbs delivers weighty bars with cool detachment over Madlib's dusty, looping production.

name: Danny Brown - Ain't It Funny (Official Video, dir. Jonah Hill)

description.ja: Jonah Hill監督による悪夢的な映像美と、Danny Brownの狂気じみたフロウが交錯するカオスな一曲。
description.en: A chaotic collision of Danny Brown's manic flow and Jonah Hill's nightmarish visual direction.

description.ja: レーガン政権以降のアメリカを鋭く批判する、コンシャス・ラップの金字塔。
description.en: A razor-sharp critique of post-Reagan America, standing as a landmark of conscious rap.

description.ja: DJ Premierのビートに乗せ、社会構造を数字で暴くMos Defの知性派リリシズム。
description.en: Over a DJ Premier beat, Mos Def uses numbers to expose social structures in this classic of intellectual lyricism.

description.ja: 父との確執と孤独を静かに吐露する、Earl Sweatshirtの内省的な代表曲。
description.en: Earl Sweatshirt quietly unpacks his estrangement from his father and his own isolation in this introspective signature track.

description.ja: 日本のヒップホップ文化への矜持を明快な言葉で刻んだ、RHYMESTER初期の代表曲。
description.en: An early RHYMESTER classic that turns devotion to hip-hop culture into a clear, enduring statement.

description.ja: KREVAのメロディアスなラップをバンド編成で再録した、柔らかな余韻のラブソング。
description.en: KREVA revisits his melodic love song with a full-band arrangement and a warm, lingering groove.

name: KREVA - イッサイガッサイ

description.ja: 夏の高揚と終わりの寂しさを軽やかなフロウで描く、KREVAを代表する一曲。
description.en: A signature KREVA track balancing carefree summer energy with the melancholy of the season ending.

description.ja: 喪失と再起、自らのルーツを壮大なスケールで語るAwichの自伝的アンセム。
description.en: Awich transforms loss, resilience, and her Okinawan roots into a sweeping autobiographical anthem.

description.ja: 生演奏のしなやかなグルーヴとKID FRESINOのラップが自然に交差する開放的な一曲。
description.en: KID FRESINO glides across a supple live-band groove in an open, genre-blurring performance.

description.ja: 鋭いビートの上でKID FRESINOとNENEの異なるフロウが鮮やかに噛み合うコラボレーション。
description.en: KID FRESINO and NENE lock contrasting flows into a crisp, restless beat.

description.ja: KID FRESINOとJJJが抑制の効いたビートで言葉を交わす、静かな緊張感を持つ一曲。
description.en: KID FRESINO and JJJ trade measured verses over restrained production with a quiet tension.

name: C.O.S.A. × KID FRESINO - Swing at Somewhere feat. コトリンゴ

description.ja: コトリンゴの歌声と繊細なプロダクションに、二人のラップが溶け込む叙情的な楽曲。
description.en: C.O.S.A. and KID FRESINO blend reflective verses with Kotringo's voice and delicate production.

name: KOHH - 貧乏なんて気にしない

description.ja: 物質的な豊かさより心の在り方を選ぶ価値観を、率直な言葉で示したKOHH初期の代表曲。
description.en: An early KOHH standout that values inner wealth over appearances through direct, memorable writing.

name: CHICO CARLITO - Let Go feat. 柊人 / THE FIRST TAKE

description.ja: 沖縄から東京へ移った実感を、柊人とのライブバンド編成でまっすぐ届ける一発撮り。
description.en: CHICO CARLITO and Shuto deliver a one-take live-band reflection on leaving Okinawa for Tokyo.

description.ja: 荒い質感のサンプルと鋭いドラムでJPEGMAFIAの実験性と攻撃性を凝縮した代表曲。
description.en: A defining JPEGMAFIA cut that compresses abrasive samples, sharp drums, and confrontational energy.

description.ja: 高揚感あるゴスペルサンプルを歪んだ低音で押し切る、JPEGMAFIA屈指の爆発的な一曲。
description.en: JPEGMAFIA drives an uplifting gospel sample through distorted bass in one of his most explosive tracks.

description.ja: Madlibの柔らかなソウルループにFreddie Gibbsの硬質な語り口が映える『Bandana』期の名曲。
description.en: Freddie Gibbs' hard-edged storytelling cuts through Madlib's warm soul loop on this Bandana standout.

description.ja: 陽気な西海岸サウンドの裏にロングビーチの日常を映す、軽快さと批評性が同居する一曲。
description.en: Vince Staples pairs bright West Coast bounce with a sharper look at everyday life in Long Beach.

name: Pusha T - If You Know You Know

description.ja: Kanye Westの緊張感あるプロダクションに、Pusha Tの冷徹なディテール描写が乗る『DAYTONA』の冒頭曲。
description.en: Pusha T opens DAYTONA with icy detail and controlled menace over tense Kanye West production.

description.ja: J Dillaの温かなビートに誠実な愛情表現を乗せた、コンシャス・ヒップホップの名曲。
description.en: Common places an openhearted love letter over J Dilla's warm production in a conscious-rap classic.

name: Earl Sweatshirt feat. Vince Staples & Casey Veggies - Hive

description.ja: 重くミニマルなビートに三者の低温なラップが絡む、『Doris』を象徴する不穏な一曲。
description.en: Earl Sweatshirt, Vince Staples, and Casey Veggies move through a heavy minimalist beat with controlled menace.

description.ja: 生楽器の厚いグルーヴを自在なフロウで乗りこなす、Little Simzの堂々たるパフォーマンス。
description.en: Little Simz commands a rich live-instrument groove with agile flows and effortless presence.

description.ja: デトロイトでの少年時代とラッパーへの夢をユーモラスかつ鮮明に振り返る自伝的ナンバー。
description.en: Danny Brown looks back on childhood in Detroit and his dream of rapping with vivid humor and detail.

name: Run The Jewels - Legend Has It

description.ja: El-Pの硬質なビート上でKiller Mikeとの高速マイクリレーが炸裂する、RTJ屈指のバンガー。
description.en: El-P and Killer Mike unleash rapid-fire chemistry over a hard mechanical beat in an essential RTJ banger.

name: NITRO MICROPHONE UNDERGROUND - STRAIGHT FROM THE UNDERGROUND

description.ja: 8人のMCが次々とマイクをつなぎ、NITROならではの重量感と集団の迫力を刻む一曲。
description.en: Eight MCs trade verses with the weight, variety, and collective force that define NITRO MICROPHONE UNDERGROUND.

description.ja: 抑制の効いたビートと滑らかなフロウで、距離のある関係への思いを静かに描くKEIJUの代表曲。
description.en: KEIJU pairs a restrained beat with a smooth flow, quietly tracing the uncertainty of a distant relationship.

description.ja: 細かなリズムの切り替えと鋭い言葉選びで、消えない意志を前面に押し出すBonberoの一曲。
description.en: Bonbero uses quick rhythmic turns and tightly chosen words to foreground a determination that refuses to fade.

description.ja: 雨の情景に内省的な言葉と落ち着いたフロウを重ねた、Daichi Yamamotoの空気感が光る一曲。
description.en: Daichi Yamamoto layers reflective writing and an unhurried flow over a rain-soaked, atmospheric backdrop.

description.ja: 流れるようなバンドサウンドに日々の一瞬をすくい取る言葉を乗せた、開放感のあるナンバー。
description.en: Ryohu captures fleeting moments of everyday life over a flowing live-band arrangement with an open, easy feel.

description.ja: Double Clapperzの硬質なビートを低い声と緻密なフロウで制圧する、ralphの存在感が際立つ一曲。
description.en: ralph commands Double Clapperz's hard-edged production with a low register and meticulously controlled flow.

description.ja: メロディアスな声の揺れと華やかなプロダクションが交差する、LEXの感情表現を凝縮した楽曲。
description.en: LEX condenses his emotive melodic delivery into a track where vocal shifts meet bright, polished production.

name: C.O.S.A. × KID FRESINO - LOVE (Prod by jjj)

description.ja: jjjの穏やかなビート上で、C.O.S.A.とKID FRESINOが異なる距離感から愛を語る共作。
description.en: Over jjj's mellow production, C.O.S.A. and KID FRESINO approach love from distinct but complementary perspectives.

description.ja: 浮遊感のあるトラックと二人の軽やかなメロディが溶け合う、Mall Boyzの高揚感あるアンセム。
description.en: Tohji and gummyboy blend airy melodies with weightless production in an uplifting Mall Boyz anthem.

description.ja: Ramzaの歪んだグルーヴを背景に、Campanellaと鎮座DOPENESSの奔放な言葉が跳ね回る一曲。
description.en: Campanella and Chinza DOPENESS bounce free-form verses across Ramza's warped, elastic groove.

description.ja: 世代の狭間に立つ自身の位置を整理しながら、競争と敬意を両立させるJ. Coleの自己分析。
description.en: J. Cole examines his place between rap generations, balancing competitive focus with respect for both sides.

description.ja: 荒々しいブラスと短く鋭い展開で、Tylerの成功への自負を一気に叩きつける楽曲。
description.en: Tyler, The Creator delivers a compact burst of confidence over abrasive brass and sharply cut production.

name: A$AP Rocky - Praise The Lord (Da Shine) feat. Skepta

description.ja: 笛のループと弾むドラムにRockyとSkeptaのフロウが絡む、米英の接続を象徴するヒット。
description.en: A looping flute and bouncing drums frame Rocky and Skepta's chemistry in a defining US-UK crossover.

description.ja: 霞んだサンプルと余裕あるフロウで、A$AP Rocky初期の美学を鮮明に示したブレイク曲。
description.en: Hazy sampling and an effortless flow capture the early A$AP Rocky aesthetic in a defining breakout track.

description.ja: 日々を生き抜く人々の現実と尊厳を、力強い声と高揚感あるビートで描くコンシャス・ラップの名曲。
description.en: Talib Kweli honors the struggle and dignity of everyday survival with an urgent voice and uplifting production.

description.ja: 穏やかな前半から重いビートへ転じ、逆境の中でも歩みを止めない意志を段階的に高める一曲。
description.en: Denzel Curry moves from a calm opening into a heavier beat, steadily building a statement of persistence through adversity.

description.ja: シカゴで生きる緊張と喪失を、跳ねるビートと切迫した語りで描き切るSabaの代表曲。
description.en: Saba channels the tension and loss of life in Chicago through urgent storytelling and a restless, bouncing beat.

name: Dizzee Rascal - Fix Up, Look Sharp

description.ja: 巨大なドラムと切れ味鋭いフロウで、初期グライムの衝撃を広く伝えたDizzee Rascalの代表曲。
description.en: Dizzee Rascal's razor-edged flow and massive drums carried the shock of early grime to a wider audience.

description.ja: 地元Streathamの現実と自身の歩みを、冷静な観察と緊張感ある言葉で描くDaveの一曲。
description.en: Dave maps the realities of Streatham and his own path through controlled observation and tightly wound writing.

description.ja: Daveの落ち着いたラップとBurna Boyの旋律が自然に交差する、軽やかで温度の高いクロスオーバー。
description.en: Dave's relaxed delivery and Burna Boy's melody meet in a warm, effortless crossover with lasting bounce.

name: MNNK Bro. (Takashi Murakami & JP THE WAVY) - LV MURAKAMI (Official Music Video)

description.ja: 村上隆とJP THE WAVYが、ラグジュアリーとポップアートを鮮烈なラップビジュアルへまとめた一曲。
description.en: Takashi Murakami and JP THE WAVY turn luxury and pop art into a vivid rap visual with unmistakable color.

description.ja: LEXのメロディックな感覚と率直な声が、短い言葉の中に強い輪郭を作る。
description.en: LEX's melodic instinct and direct voice give a sharp outline to every compact phrase.

name: Awich, Jay Park, KR$NA, Masiwei & VannDa - ASIAN STATE OF MIND (Prod. Diego Ave)

description.ja: Awichを軸にアジア各地のMCが言語と国境を横断する、スケールの大きなマイクリレー。
description.en: Led by Awich, MCs from across Asia cross languages and borders in a genuinely widescreen relay.

description.ja: ¥ellow BucksとLANAが、艶のあるフックと堂々としたラップで華やかな強さを作る。
description.en: ¥ellow Bucks and LANA pair a glossy hook with commanding rap presence for a polished show of strength.

description.ja: 3Houseの柔らかな歌声とKohjiyaのフロウが、夜の空気に合う滑らかなR&B／ラップを作る。
description.en: 3House's soft vocals and Kohjiya's flow meet in a smooth R&B-rap cut built for late-night air.

name: Bonbero - 飛行機雲 feat. EMI MARIA (Music Video)

description.ja: Bonberoの繊細なラップとEMI MARIAの歌が、浮遊感と切なさを同じ景色に重ねる。
description.en: Bonbero's detailed rap and EMI MARIA's vocals layer weightlessness and longing into the same view.

description.ja: Watsonの生活感あるディテールと独特の間が、飾らない言葉に強い推進力を与える。
description.en: Watson's lived-in details and distinctive pauses give his unvarnished writing a powerful forward pull.

name: Jin Dogg - 街風 feat. REAL-T (Official Music Video)

description.ja: Jin DoggとREAL-Tが、街の緊張感を低く重い声と生々しい描写で刻む大阪ストリートラップ。
description.en: Jin Dogg and REAL-T carve Osaka street tension into low, heavy voices and unfiltered detail.

name: OZworld - IROCHIGAI feat. 唾奇 (prod. Ryosuke Dr.R Sakai)

description.ja: OZworldの色彩感覚と唾奇の落ち着いた言葉が交差する、沖縄発のサイケデリックな一曲。
description.en: OZworld's vivid imagination meets Tsubaki's grounded writing in a psychedelic cut rooted in Okinawa.

name: Clipse - So Be It (Official Music Video)

description.ja: Clipseの冷徹な掛け合いと鋭い余白が、再始動後も変わらない緊張感を生む。
description.en: Clipse return with cold exchanges and razor-sharp space, preserving the tension that made the duo singular.

name: Tyler, The Creator - STOP PLAYING WITH ME (Official Video)

description.ja: Tyler, The Creatorの荒々しいユーモアとデザイン感覚が、短く強烈な映像とビートに凝縮される。
description.en: Tyler, The Creator compresses abrasive humor and sharp design into a short, forceful burst of sound and image.

description.ja: Kendrick LamarとSZAが、柔らかなソウルの質感に親密なラップと歌を重ねる。
description.en: Kendrick Lamar and SZA layer intimate rap and vocals over a soft, soul-rich backdrop.

description.ja: Doechiiが不安定な感情を変幻自在のフロウへ変え、ポップな輪郭の中に緊張を残す。
description.en: Doechii turns unstable emotion into shape-shifting flow, leaving real tension inside a pop-sized frame.

description.ja: Little Simzの精密なラップが、重層的なビートのうねりを押し切るように進む。
description.en: Little Simz drives precise writing through a layered beat that keeps swelling beneath her.

description.ja: Central Ceeが余計な説明を削ぎ落とし、乾いたビートの上で存在感だけを残す。
description.en: Central Cee strips away the extra explanation and lets his presence sit plainly over a dry, controlled beat.

description.ja: SkeptaとFinessekidが、鋭いドラムと警報のような緊張感をロンドンとアイルランドの接点へ運ぶ。
description.en: Skepta and Finessekid carry sharp drums and siren-like tension into a London-Ireland connection.

description.ja: Daveの内省的な語りとTemsの深い歌声が、雨のように静かな余韻を広げる。
description.en: Dave's reflective delivery and Tems' deep vocal tone spread a quiet, rain-soaked afterglow.

name: J Hus - Gold (Official Video) ft. Asake

description.ja: J HusとAsakeが、UKラップとアフロビーツのリズムを軽やかなフックで接続する。
description.en: J Hus and Asake connect UK rap and Afrobeats rhythm through an easy, bright hook.

description.ja: Travis Scottが歪んだ低音と巨大な空間処理で、短いフレーズをスタジアム級の圧へ変える。
description.en: Travis Scott turns short phrases into stadium-scale pressure through distorted bass and cavernous space.

description.ja: SUSHIBOYSが賃貸生活の実感を、軽快なビートと生活感のある言葉で走らせる。
description.en: SUSHIBOYS turn the realities of rental life into a nimble track driven by everyday detail.

description.ja: SEEDAとVERBALが長い時間を越えて言葉を交わす、和解と継承のメモリアルな一曲。
description.en: SEEDA and VERBAL meet across years of history for a reflective track about reconciliation and legacy.

name: Kvi Baba / I Like It (Remix) feat. R-指定 -Live at NIPPON BUDOKAN-

description.ja: Kvi Babaの柔らかなフックにR-指定の緻密なバースが重なる、日本武道館でのライブ版。
description.en: Kvi Baba's relaxed hook meets R-Shitei's tightly written verse in this Nippon Budokan performance.

name: YENTOWN - Asobo Feat. Awich, MonyHorse, PETZ, JNKMN & kZm (Prod. Chaki Zulu)

description.ja: YENTOWNの面々がChaki Zuluのピアノを軸に、遊びと挑戦をクルーの熱量へ変える。
description.en: YENTOWN turn play and ambition into crew energy over Chaki Zulu's piano-led production.

description.ja: Worldwide Skippaがキャッチーなラインと鋭いスタンスを短い展開へ詰め込む。
description.en: Worldwide Skippa packs sharp positions and instantly quotable lines into a compact statement.

name: 唾奇 - 南無阿弥陀仏 Prod.KM (Official Video)

description.ja: 唾奇の落ち着いた語りとKMの奥行きあるビートが、生と現実を静かに見つめる。
description.en: Tsubaki's measured delivery and KM's spacious beat hold a quiet gaze on life and reality.

name: ピーナッツくん - KIRINAI feat. Kamui (Official Visualiser)

description.ja: ピーナッツくんとKamuiが、切れ味のある電子音とラップで境界を押し広げる。
description.en: Peanuts-kun and Kamui push at genre boundaries with sharp electronic textures and agile rap.

description.ja: MFSが身軽なフロウと硬質なリズムで、関西シーンらしい推進力を見せる。
description.en: MFS rides a hard-edged rhythm with nimble flow and the forward pull of Kansai's scene.

name: Nef The Pharaoh - D.O.A. (Official Video) ft. Magic4z, ISAAC5

description.ja: Nef The Pharaohが若い共演者とともに、ベイエリアらしい軽快なバウンスを受け渡す。
description.en: Nef The Pharaoh passes Bay Area bounce to Magic4z and ISAAC5 in an easygoing crew cut.

description.ja: Kuriousがブロンクスの記憶と現在を、滑らかなGファンクの感触に重ねる。
description.en: Kurious connects Bronx memory and present-day detail over a smooth G-funk glide.

name: Aspen Kartier ft. Lady Binladen - Free Clout (Official Video)

description.ja: Aspen KartierとLady Binladenが高速の掛け合いで、シカゴドリルの緊張を更新する。
description.en: Aspen Kartier and Lady Binladen update Chicago drill tension through rapid-fire interplay.

description.ja: CUZZOSが複数人のキャラクターと西海岸のバウンスを、遊び心あるフックへまとめる。
description.en: CUZZOS fold a full cast of personalities and West Coast bounce into a playful hook.

description.ja: Monaleoがヒューストン由来の言葉遣いと堂々たるフロウで、祝祭感のある一曲を作る。
description.en: Monaleo turns Houston language and commanding flow into a bright, celebratory record.

description.ja: Niontayが濁ったビートの上を、フロリダの言葉とひねりの効いたパンチラインで滑る。
description.en: Niontay glides across a murky beat with Florida language and sly, tightly placed punchlines.

name: Kofi Stone - Venice ft. Maverick Sabre (Official Music Video)

description.ja: Kofi Stoneの温かな語りとMaverick Sabreの歌声が、ソウルフルなUKラップを描く。
description.en: Kofi Stone's warm narration and Maverick Sabre's vocal create a soulful UK rap reflection.

description.ja: Lord Apexが煙たいビートへ自然体のフロウを置き、ロンドンの地下感を保つ。
description.en: Lord Apex places an unforced flow over hazy production while keeping London's underground feel intact.

description.ja: JianboとNamaniが英国と西アフリカの感触を、しなやかなリズムの上で結ぶ。
description.en: Jianbo and Namani connect British and West African textures over a supple rhythmic pocket.

description.ja: Finessekidが鋭いドリルの間合いと冷静なデリバリーで、新世代UKの存在感を示す。
description.en: Finessekid uses crisp drill spacing and controlled delivery to mark out a new UK presence.

name: Jeshi - DISCONNECT! feat. Fredwave, Louis Culture & J. Caesar (Official Video)

description.ja: Jeshiら4人が断片的な声と不穏なビートを交差させ、都市の焦燥を一曲へ封じる。
description.en: Jeshi and his collaborators cross fragmented voices with uneasy production to capture urban restlessness.

description.ja: namesblissがグライムの輪郭と内省的な言葉を、落ち着いた推進力にまとめる。
description.en: namesbliss balances grime contours and reflective writing with calm forward motion.

description.ja: PSGの3人が肩の力を抜いた言葉と温かなループで、身近な人や音楽への愛情を綴る。
description.en: PSG pair relaxed verses with a warm loop, writing openly about affection for the people and music around them.

description.ja: S.L.A.C.K.が乾いたドラムと親密な語り口で、東京の生活感を淡い余韻へ変える。
description.en: S.L.A.C.K. turns everyday Tokyo detail into a hazy afterglow through dry drums and an intimate delivery.

name: NORIKIYO from SD JUNKSTA - 仕事しよう

description.ja: NORIKIYOが働くことと街で生き抜く現実を、ユーモアと切実さの両方を込めて描く。
description.en: NORIKIYO examines work and survival in the city with a balance of humor, pressure, and street-level realism.

name: Danger Mouse & Black Thought - Belize (feat. MF DOOM)

description.ja: Black ThoughtとMF DOOMの緻密なライムを、Danger Mouseの陰影あるプロダクションが包む。
description.en: Danger Mouse frames densely written verses from Black Thought and MF DOOM with shadowy, cinematic production.

description.ja: MIKEがくぐもったサンプルと内省的なフロウで、欠落や渇望の感覚を静かに掘り下げる。
description.en: MIKE uses a muffled sample and inward-looking flow to quietly explore absence, appetite, and emotional need.

description.ja: Earl Sweatshirtが歪んだビートを縫うようなフロウで、過去から現在までの変化を凝縮する。
description.en: Earl Sweatshirt threads a tightly compressed flow through warped production while taking stock of his path from past to present.

description.ja: Roc Marcianoが余白の大きいビートへ贅沢と危険のイメージを置き、独自の静かな威圧感を作る。
description.en: Roc Marciano sets images of luxury and danger inside spacious production, sustaining his signature quiet menace.

description.ja: Kanoがグライム黎明期の鋭いビートを自在に乗りこなし、ロンドンの緊張と自信を刻む。
description.en: Kano attacks an early-grime rhythm with precision, capturing London tension and youthful confidence in equal measure.

description.ja: CASISDEADが冷たいシンセと映画的な視点で、欲望と孤独が交差する夜の物語を描く。
description.en: CASISDEAD uses cold synths and cinematic detail to narrate a night where desire and isolation intersect.

description.ja: Ocean Wisdomが高速フロウと細かなリズムの切り替えで、UKラップの技術的な快感を押し出す。
description.en: Ocean Wisdom foregrounds the technical thrill of UK rap through rapid delivery and tightly controlled rhythmic switches.

name: kZm - Dream Chaser feat. BIM (Prod. Chaki Zulu)

description.ja: kZmとBIMがChaki Zuluの鮮やかなビートを行き来し、焦りと野心を軽やかな掛け合いへ変える。
description.en: kZm and BIM move across Chaki Zulu's vivid production, turning impatience and ambition into an effortless exchange.

name: Campanella - PELNOD feat. Yoshie Nakano (Prod. by JJJ) [Official Music Video]

description.ja: Campanellaのしなやかなライムと中納良恵の歌声を、JJJの温かなプロダクションがゆっくり結ぶ。
description.en: JJJ's warm production slowly binds Campanella's elastic rhymes with Yoshie Nakano's soulful vocal.

name: STUTS - Mirrors feat. SUMIN, Daichi Yamamoto & 鎮座DOPENESS

description.ja: STUTSがSUMINの旋律、Daichi Yamamotoと鎮座DOPENESSの異なるフロウを、色彩豊かなグルーヴへ映し出す。
description.en: STUTS reflects SUMIN's melody and the contrasting flows of Daichi Yamamoto and Chinza Dopeness through a colorful groove.

name: ENNY - Peng Black Girls feat. Amia Brave (Official Video)

description.ja: ENNYの率直な自己肯定とAmia Braveの穏やかなフックが、ブラック・ウーマンの多様な美しさを祝う。
description.en: ENNY's direct self-affirmation and Amia Brave's gentle hook celebrate the many forms of Black womanhood.

description.ja: Knucksが抑制の効いたフロウで、少年期の日常が暴力へ近づいていく過程を静かに語る。
description.en: Knucks uses a restrained flow to quietly trace how an ordinary childhood edges toward violence.

name: Loyle Carner - Ottolenghi feat. Jordan Rakei (Official Video)

description.ja: Loyle Carnerの会話のような語りとJordan Rakeiの柔らかな歌声が、旅と読書の記憶を親密にほどく。
description.en: Loyle Carner's conversational delivery and Jordan Rakei's soft vocal unfold memories of travel and reading with intimacy.

description.ja: redveilが自作の跳ねるビートへ加速するフロウを重ね、地元への誇りと上昇する意志を刻む。
description.en: redveil layers an accelerating flow over his own spring-loaded production, marking hometown pride and upward intent.

name: Isaiah Rashad - Headshots (4r Da Locals) [Official Music Video]

description.ja: Isaiah Rashadが霞んだグルーヴに力の抜けたフロウを置き、不安と依存の影を滑らかな余韻へ変える。
description.en: Isaiah Rashad lays a loose flow over a hazy groove, turning shadows of anxiety and dependence into a smooth afterglow.

description.ja: SOB X RBEの4人がベイエリアらしい弾むビートをリレーし、荒々しい勢いを車内の一体感へまとめる。
description.en: SOB X RBE relay a springy Bay Area beat, turning raw momentum into the unity of a packed car ride.

name: CEO Trayle - OK Cool (Official Music Video)

description.ja: CEO Trayleが骨組みだけのようなトラップビートへ低く引きずる声を置き、最小限の動きで緊張を作る。
description.en: CEO Trayle drags a low, unhurried voice across skeletal trap production, creating tension with minimal movement.

name: JJJ - July feat. sogumm (Prod. by ouidaehan) [Official Music Video]

description.ja: JJJの静かなフロウとsogummの浮遊する歌声が、余白の多いビートに夏の記憶と距離感を残す。
description.en: JJJ's restrained flow and sogumm's weightless vocal leave traces of summer memory and distance across a spacious beat.

name: Daichi Yamamoto - Let It Be feat. KID FRESINO (Official Music Video)

description.ja: Daichi YamamotoとKID FRESINOがジャジーな揺れを軽やかに渡り合い、肩の力を抜いた会話へ変える。
description.en: Daichi Yamamoto and KID FRESINO trade nimble verses over a jazzy sway, turning the track into an easygoing conversation.

description.ja: 田我流が淡いシンセとゆるいドラムの上を漂い、流れていく街の景色を少し切ない余韻へ変える。
description.en: Dengaryu drifts over pale synths and loose drums, turning passing city scenery into a gently bittersweet afterglow.

description.ja: Navy Blueが埃っぽいソウルのループに内省的な言葉を重ね、静かな確信へ少しずつ登っていく。
description.en: Navy Blue layers inward-looking verses over a dusty soul loop, gradually climbing toward a quiet sense of conviction.

name: AKAI SOLO - Incursio Fur (Prod. Navy Blue) [Official Video]

description.ja: AKAI SOLOがNavy Blueの歪んだループへ密度の高い言葉を刻み、短い尺に思考の迷路を作る。
description.en: AKAI SOLO carves dense language into Navy Blue's warped loop, building a maze of thought inside a compact runtime.

description.ja: MAVIがくぐもったサンプルの隙間へ言葉を連ね、わずかな時間に焦燥と自己対話を凝縮する。
description.en: MAVI threads words through a muffled sample, compressing urgency and self-dialogue into barely more than a minute.

name: Pink Siifu - Stay Sane (Prod. Navy Blue)

description.ja: Pink Siifuが霞んだソウルの断片に親密な声を置き、崩れそうな感情を静かな反復でつなぎ止める。
description.en: Pink Siifu places an intimate voice over hazy soul fragments, holding frayed emotion together through quiet repetition.

description.ja: LORD APEXが煙たいブーンバップに低く落ち着いたフロウを滑らせ、日常の小さな勝利を確かな手触りにする。
description.en: LORD APEX glides a low, composed flow across smoky boom bap, giving everyday victories a tangible sense of weight.

description.ja: Jeshiが痙攣するような電子ビートを切迫したフロウで駆け抜け、都市の不安を前進する力へ変える。
description.en: Jeshi races across a twitching electronic beat with an urgent flow, turning urban anxiety into forward motion.

description.ja: Little Simzが跳ねるビートに若い頃の景色を鮮明に並べ、ロンドンの記憶をラジオ番組のように走らせる。
description.en: Little Simz lines up vivid scenes from her younger years over a bouncing beat, sending London memories through the track like a radio broadcast.

name: Oxmo Puccino - L'enfant seul [Official Music Video]

description.ja: Oxmo Puccinoが孤独な少年の視点から街と家庭を描き、物語を追うようなラップで一人の成長を刻む。
description.en: Oxmo Puccino writes from a lonely child's point of view, tracing home, the street, and growing up through tightly observed storytelling.

description.ja: IAMが少年を取り巻く誘惑と現実を具体的な場面でつなぎ、世代を越えて残る社会派の物語にする。
description.en: IAM connects the pressures and temptations surrounding a young boy through concrete scenes, building a social narrative that still carries across generations.

name: Little Brother - Lovin' It (feat. Joe Scudda) [Official Video]

description.ja: Little BrotherとJoe Scuddaが9th Wonderのソウルフルなビートを受け渡し、軽快な掛け合いにラップへの愛を詰め込む。
description.en: Little Brother and Joe Scudda trade verses over 9th Wonder's soulful production, packing their love of rap into an easy, agile exchange.

description.ja: Digable Planetsがジャズの響きと三者三様のフロウを重ね、自分たちの出自を街のスナップのように見せる。
description.en: Digable Planets layer jazz textures with three distinct flows, presenting where they come from as a sequence of street-level snapshots.

name: The Streets - Has It Come to This? (Official Video)

description.ja: Mike SkinnerがUKガラージの隙間へ日常会話のようなラップを置き、部屋と街の距離を一気に縮める。
description.en: Mike Skinner drops conversational rap into the spaces of UK garage, collapsing the distance between a small room and the city outside.

description.ja: Lady Leshurrが言葉遊びと鋭い切り返しを息継ぎなく畳みかけ、一本の路上映像を圧倒的なショーに変える。
description.en: Lady Leshurr fires off wordplay and sharp reversals without pause, turning a single street performance into a commanding show.

name: Twice In A Lifetime - ISSUGI / prod. DJ SCRATCH NICE (Official Video)

description.ja: ISSUGIがDJ SCRATCH NICEのソウルフルなビートへ揺るがない言葉を置き、街を滑る映像と5lackのフックを一本につなぐ。
description.en: ISSUGI sets unwavering bars over DJ SCRATCH NICE's soulful beat, joining a glide through the city with a hook from 5lack.

description.ja: OMSBが志人と玉兎「前世」のトラックを組み替え、生と死を見つめる言葉を重厚な映像へ刻み込む。
description.en: OMSB reshapes a track from “Zensei,” engraving a meditation on life and death into a weighty visual.

name: Khundi Panda - Somozu Fever [Official Music Video]

description.ja: Khundi Pandaがyagancampの硬質なビートを細かな抑揚で切り分け、低彩度のアニメーションと緊張感を揃える。
description.en: Khundi Panda slices through yagancamp's hard-edged beat with fine shifts in cadence, matching the tension of its muted animation.

name: Balming Tiger - 'Armadillo' (Feat. Omega Sapien, Byung Un)[Official Video]

description.ja: Omega SapienとByung Unが歪んだ低音の上を大胆に往復し、Balming Tigerの集団性を奇妙で鮮烈な映像に焼き付ける。
description.en: Omega Sapien and Byung Un move boldly across distorted low end, stamping Balming Tiger's collective energy into a strange, vivid visual.

description.ja: dodoが飾らない言葉と柔らかなメロディを重ね、身近な記憶を静かにほどいていく。
description.en: dodo layers plainspoken lines with a gentle melody, quietly unfolding memories drawn from everyday life.

description.ja: MUDが重いベースと鋭いドラムを押し進み、迷いを断ち切るようなフロウで曲を引き締める。
description.en: MUD drives through heavy bass and sharp drums, tightening the track with a flow that cuts through hesitation.

name: What is your name？- SUSHIBOYS（Official Music Video）

description.ja: SUSHIBOYSが名前をめぐる問いを軽快な掛け合いへ変え、ユーモアと勢いを一つの映像に詰め込む。
description.en: SUSHIBOYS turn a question about names into a quick exchange, packing humor and momentum into a single visual.

description.ja: Quelle Chrisが友情の距離感を乾いたユーモアで描き、素朴なビートの上に会話のようなラップを置く。
description.en: Quelle Chris examines the distance inside friendship with dry humor, placing conversational rap over a spare beat.

name: Fly Anakin - No Dough (Prod. by Madlib) (Official Video)

description.ja: Fly AnakinがMadlibのざらついたループへ細かな韻を滑り込ませ、短い尺を濃密なラップで満たす。
description.en: Fly Anakin slips tightly packed rhymes into Madlib's grainy loop, filling a compact runtime with dense rap.

description.ja: Maxoが時間と成長を見つめる言葉を静かなビートへ置き、内省を急がずに積み重ねる。
description.en: Maxo sets reflections on time and growth against a subdued beat, letting each thought accumulate without rushing.

name: The Alchemist - "TV Dinners" featuring Sideshow & Boldy James

description.ja: SideshowとBoldy JamesがThe Alchemistの不穏なループを低い体温で渡り合い、街の細部を淡々と切り取る。
description.en: Sideshow and Boldy James trade low-key verses over The Alchemist's uneasy loop, calmly isolating details from the street.

description.ja: BXKSが跳ねるビートへ歯切れのよいフロウを連射し、コンパクトな曲を鋭い推進力で走らせる。
description.en: BXKS fires clipped flows across a spring-loaded beat, driving the compact track with sharp forward motion.

description.ja: Kwengfaceが硬いドリルのビートを畳みかけるフロウで押し切り、緊張を最後まで途切れさせない。
description.en: Kwengface powers through a hard drill beat with a relentless flow, keeping the tension intact from start to finish.

description.ja: Coopsがジャズの余韻を残すビートへ落ち着いたフロウを重ね、ロンドンの街角をゆっくりと巡る。
description.en: Coops layers an unhurried flow over a beat with lingering jazz tones, moving slowly through London street scenes.

description.ja: Roots Manuvaが重く跳ねる低音と反復するフックを軸に、英国ラップの輪郭を鮮明に刻む。
description.en: Roots Manuva builds around heavy, spring-loaded bass and a repeating hook, drawing a sharp outline of British rap.

description.ja: Klashnekoffが硬質なドラムへ密度の高い言葉を連ね、2000年代ロンドンの緊張感を映し出す。
description.en: Klashnekoff stacks densely packed bars over hard drums, capturing the tension of 2000s London.

description.ja: スチャダラパーが真夏の街の温度と気だるさを会話のようなラップで切り取り、季節の定番へ変えた。
description.en: Schadaraparr turns the heat and languor of a city summer into a seasonal staple through conversational rap.

description.ja: LAMP EYEのビートに複数のMCがマイクをつなぎ、日本語ラップの技量と存在感を一曲へ集約する。
description.en: A relay of MCs passes the microphone over LAMP EYE's production, concentrating Japanese rap skill and presence into one track.

name: MC Solaar - Bouge de là (Clip officiel)

description.ja: MC Solaarが軽快なサンプルと語り口で場面を次々に切り替え、フランス語ラップ初期の広がりを示す。
description.en: MC Solaar moves through a sequence of scenes with nimble storytelling and a bright sample, marking French rap's early expansion.

name: Suprême NTM - Ma Benz (Clip officiel) ft. Lord Kossity

description.ja: Suprême NTMとLord Kossityが低くうねるビートを乗り継ぎ、フランスのラップとダンスホールを接続する。
description.en: Suprême NTM and Lord Kossity ride a low-slung groove that connects French rap with dancehall.

name: Fly (Feat. Amin. J of Soulciety) | Epik High

description.ja: Epik Highが歯切れのよいラップと大きく開くコーラスを組み合わせ、前進する力をポップな構成へ落とし込む。
description.en: Epik High pairs crisp verses with a wide-open chorus, shaping forward momentum into a pop-minded rap structure.

name: Ring My Bell (Feat. 나얼 Of Brown Eyed Soul) | Dynamicduo

description.ja: Dynamicduoの掛け合いとナオルの歌声がファンクを帯びたビート上で交差し、ラップとR&Bを滑らかにつなぐ。
description.en: Dynamicduo's back-and-forth verses meet Naul's singing over a funk-leaning beat, smoothly linking rap and R&B.

description.ja: ProdigyがThe Alchemistの乾いたループを最小限の動きで制し、短い尺へ鋭いラインを詰め込む。
description.en: Prodigy controls The Alchemist's dry loop with minimal movement, packing sharp lines into a compact runtime.

name: Black Moon - How Many M.C.'s (Official Music Video)

description.ja: Black Moonが荒いドラムと低いベースの上でMCの力量を問い、ブルックリンのブームバップを押し出す。
description.en: Black Moon questions an MC's credentials over rugged drums and low bass, pushing Brooklyn boom bap to the front.

name: Campanella - Douglas fir (Prod by Ramza)【Official Music Video】

description.ja: CampanellaがRamzaの細部まで組まれたビートを自在に横切り、名古屋の街と自身の視点を映像へ重ねる。
description.en: Campanella moves freely through Ramza's intricately built production, layering his perspective over images of Nagoya.

description.ja: 鎮座DOPENESSが言葉の響きと間を遊びながら、身近な情景を即興性の高いフロウへ変えていく。
description.en: Chinza Dopeness plays with sound and timing, turning everyday scenes into a highly improvisational flow.

name: Boldy James - Speed Demon Freestyle (Prod. The Alchemist)

description.ja: Boldy JamesがThe Alchemistの硬質なループへ抑制された声を置き、短い映像の中へデトロイトの描写を詰め込む。
description.en: Boldy James places a restrained delivery over The Alchemist's hard-edged loop, packing Detroit detail into a compact video.

name: Your Old Droog - Bangladesh ft. Heems

description.ja: Your Old DroogとHeemsが皮肉と細かな引用を往復させ、ニューヨークの多文化的な日常を乾いたビートに刻む。
description.en: Your Old Droog and Heems trade irony and tightly packed references, setting multicultural New York life against a dry beat.

name: Kojey Radical, Mahalia, Swindle - Water (Official Video)

description.ja: Kojey Radicalの語りかけるラップ、Mahaliaの歌声、Swindleの演奏が交差し、家族と継承を一つの物語にする。
description.en: Kojey Radical's spoken delivery, Mahalia's singing, and Swindle's musicianship meet in a story about family and inheritance.

description.ja: Lex Amorが低く落ち着いた声と簡潔な言葉で、ロンドンの生活感を余白の多いプロダクションへ置いていく。
description.en: Lex Amor uses a low, measured voice and concise writing to place London life inside spacious production.

description.ja: Josmanが反復する鍵盤と重い低音の上でフロウを細かく切り替え、欲望と距離感を冷静に描く。
description.en: Josman shifts his flow over repeating keys and heavy bass, calmly tracing desire and emotional distance.

description.ja: Népalが淡いサンプルの上へ内省的な言葉を連ね、パリの夜景と個人的な時間を静かに結びつける。
description.en: Népal threads introspective writing through a hazy sample, quietly connecting Paris at night with private time.

name: 넉살 (Nucksal) - Skill Skill Skill (feat. DJ Wegun) M/V

description.ja: NucksalがDJ Wegunのスクラッチを挟みながら韻と速度を自在に操り、MCとしての技術を正面から示す。
description.en: Nucksal controls rhyme and pace around DJ Wegun's scratches, putting his technical command as an MC front and center.

name: Paid in Seoul (Feat. Woo) | DON MALIK

description.ja: DON MALIKとWooがソウルで生きる現実と野心を交互に描き、太いドラムへ輪郭の異なるフロウを重ねる。
description.en: DON MALIK and Woo alternate between Seoul realities and ambition, layering contrasting flows over thick drums.

name: Campanella - PEASTA @ りんご音楽祭2016

description.ja: Campanellaが野外ステージでビートの細かな揺れを捉え、言葉と身体を連動させるライブ映像。
description.en: Campanella catches every small shift in the beat on an outdoor stage, linking his words and physical movement.

name: 田我流【MV】やべ〜勢いですげー盛り上がる

description.ja: 田我流が仲間と街へ繰り出し、タイトル通りの高揚をユーモアと集団の熱量で押し広げる。
description.en: Dengaryu heads into the streets with his crew, expanding the title's rush through humor and collective energy.

name: MONJU - Ear to street (Official Music Video)

description.ja: MONJUの3人が乾いたドラムの上で視点を受け渡し、東京の路上に根差した言葉を積み上げる。
description.en: MONJU's three members pass perspectives across dry drums, building verses rooted in Tokyo street life.

description.ja: 仙人掌が成長と生活の断片を抑えた語り口でつなぎ、個人的な記憶を都市の風景へ重ねる。
description.en: Senninsho connects fragments of growth and daily life in a restrained delivery, layering private memory over city scenes.

description.ja: C.O.S.A.とKID FRESINOが夕暮れの時間感覚を異なるフロウで描き、静かな余韻を残す。
description.en: C.O.S.A. and KID FRESINO describe the passing light of sundown through contrasting flows and a lingering finish.

description.ja: VaVaとtofubeatsがデジタルな質感と軽やかなフックを組み合わせ、オンライン越しの感情を描く。
description.en: VaVa and tofubeats combine digital textures with a light hook to portray emotion mediated through online space.

description.ja: MIKEが歪んだサンプルの隙間へ低い声を置き、身近な不安と観察を短い言葉で結ぶ。
description.en: MIKE places his low voice between warped samples, joining close observation and anxiety in compact lines.

description.ja: WikiがNavy Blueのビート上でニューヨークの屋上と生活を細かく描き、街の距離感を言葉にする。
description.en: Wiki details rooftops and daily New York life over Navy Blue's production, turning the city's proximity into verse.

description.ja: MAVIが密度の高い言葉で自己理解と周囲との関係をたどり、揺れる内面を一続きのフロウへする。
description.en: MAVI traces self-understanding and relationships through dense writing, shaping inner uncertainty into a continuous flow.

description.ja: Maxoが家族や成長について静かに振り返り、温度を抑えたビートへ率直な言葉を重ねる。
description.en: Maxo reflects quietly on family and growth, placing direct writing over understated production.

description.ja: Sideshowがざらついたループの上で移動と記憶を断片的に語り、短い曲に奥行きをつくる。
description.en: Sideshow speaks in fragments about movement and memory over a rough loop, giving a short track unusual depth.

name: Pink Siifu - Bussin’ (Cold) ft. Turich Benjy

description.ja: Pink SiifuとTurich Benjyが崩したビートを行き来し、声の質感と反復で曲を押し進める。
description.en: Pink Siifu and Turich Benjy move through a fractured beat, driving the track with vocal texture and repetition.

description.ja: Lex Amorがロンドンの日常を低い声と短い行で切り取り、余白のあるビートへ静かに配置する。
description.en: Lex Amor captures London daily life in a low voice and short lines, placing each detail carefully in open space.

description.ja: LORD APEXが煙るようなサンプルに落ち着いたフロウを重ね、ロンドンの生活を近距離から映す。
description.en: LORD APEX layers an unhurried flow over a hazy sample, filming London life from close range.

description.ja: CoopsとElzがジャズを帯びたビートの上でそれぞれの道程を語り、視点を滑らかに受け渡す。
description.en: Coops and Elz recount their separate journeys over jazz-tinged production, passing perspective with ease.

description.ja: BXKSが細かく跳ねるドラムへ言葉を詰め、仕事量と自信を素早い切り返しで示す。
description.en: BXKS packs words into tightly bouncing drums, presenting work rate and confidence through quick pivots.

name: Knucks - Los Pollos Hermanos (Official Music Video)

description.ja: Knucksが映像作品の引用を散りばめながら物語を進め、緊張とユーモアを同じビートへ収める。
description.en: Knucks advances a story through visual references, holding tension and humor together over the same beat.

description.ja: JeshiとObongjayarが生活の圧力を荒いドラムと身体的な声で表し、切迫した映像へつなぐ。
description.en: Jeshi and Obongjayar express daily pressure through rough drums and physical voices, matched by urgent imagery.

description.ja: Alpha Wannが長いバースを精密に組み、韻と参照を連鎖させながらフランス語ラップの技術を示す。
description.en: Alpha Wann constructs an extended verse with precision, chaining rhyme and reference into a technical display.

description.ja: Luidjiが関係のすれ違いを歌とラップの境界で描き、柔らかなプロダクションへ感情の揺れを残す。
description.en: Luidji describes a relationship slipping out of alignment between singing and rap, leaving uncertainty in soft production.

description.ja: Josmanが好みと欲望を簡潔なフックへまとめ、重い低音の上で言葉の置き方を細かく変える。
description.en: Josman compresses preference and desire into a concise hook, shifting word placement over heavy bass.

description.ja: Népalが自分の軌道と周囲の変化を内省的にたどり、淡いループへ密度の高い言葉を重ねる。
description.en: Népal traces his own trajectory and changing surroundings, layering dense reflection over a muted loop.

description.ja: Dinosが遠い都市の名前を距離の比喩に使い、孤独と関係の記憶を映像とともに描く。
description.en: Dinos uses a distant city as a measure of separation, pairing images of travel with memories of loneliness and connection.

description.ja: Prince Walyが重心の低いビートへ映画的な人物描写を置き、短い行から場面を立ち上げる。
description.en: Prince Waly sets cinematic character sketches over a low-centered beat, building scenes from compact lines.

description.ja: Khundi PandaがBewhYの鋭いビート上で問いと応答を重ね、自身の立場を複数の角度から確かめる。
description.en: Khundi Panda stacks questions and answers over BewhY's sharp production, testing his position from multiple angles.

description.ja: BewhYが変則的なリズムと反復を制御し、音節ごとに強弱をつけながら堂々と展開する。
description.en: BewhY controls irregular rhythm and repetition, varying the force of each syllable through an expansive performance.

description.ja: NucksalとGaekoが緊張感のあるプロダクションを走り抜け、互いに異なる発音と速度で曲を押す。
description.en: Nucksal and Gaeko race through tense production, driving the track with distinct articulation and pace.

description.ja: DON MALIKが成功への距離と自分の姿勢を見つめ、抑制されたビートへ長いラインを滑らかに通す。
description.en: DON MALIK examines distance from success and his own stance, running long lines smoothly over restrained production.

description.ja: E SENSが書けない時間そのものを題材にし、迷いと創作への執着を率直な言葉へ変える。
description.en: E SENS makes the inability to write his subject, turning hesitation and attachment to creation into direct verse.

description.ja: JUSTHISが喪失と距離を直線的な言葉で描き、抑えた導入から感情の強度を段階的に上げる。
description.en: JUSTHIS addresses loss and distance in direct language, gradually raising the emotional force from a restrained opening.

description.ja: Mach-Hommyが短い反復と間を活かし、The Alchemistの抑えたループへ硬質なラインを刻む。
description.en: Mach-Hommy uses clipped repetition and space, carving hard-edged lines into The Alchemist's restrained loop.

description.ja: billy woodsが具体的な情景と比喩を積み重ね、Kenny Segalの不穏な音像を物語へ変える。
description.en: billy woods layers concrete scenes and metaphor, turning Kenny Segal's uneasy soundscape into narrative.

name: Armand Hammer & The Alchemist - Falling Out the Sky feat. Earl Sweatshirt

description.ja: Armand HammerとEarl Sweatshirtが断片的な記憶を持ち寄り、柔らかなループ上で視点を交差させる。
description.en: Armand Hammer and Earl Sweatshirt bring fragmented memories together, crossing perspectives over a soft loop.

description.ja: Westside GunnがApollo Brownの重いドラムとソウル断片を背に、固有名詞とアドリブで画面を組み立てる。
description.en: Westside Gunn uses names and ad-libs to build vivid frames over Apollo Brown's heavy drums and soul fragments.

name: Conway The Machine - The Cow feat. Westside Gunn

description.ja: Conwayが身体と家族に残る出来事を長いヴァースで語り、Westside Gunnが後半を引き継ぐ。
description.en: Conway recounts events carried in body and family through an extended verse before Westside Gunn takes the closing section.

name: Benny the Butcher - 5 to 50 feat. India

description.ja: Benny the Butcherが数字と時間の変化を軸に、取引の規模が変わる過程を段階的に描く。
description.en: Benny the Butcher uses numbers and passing time to trace how the scale of a transaction changes step by step.

description.ja: Westside Gunn、Conway、Bennyが短く鋭いヴァースを連結し、三者三様の声を一曲に集める。
description.en: Westside Gunn, Conway, and Benny link short, sharp verses, bringing three distinct voices into one track.

name: Freddie Gibbs & The Alchemist - Scottie Beam feat. Rick Ross

description.ja: Freddie GibbsとRick Rossが滑らかなサンプル上で、逃走と成功の場面を切り替える。
description.en: Freddie Gibbs and Rick Ross shift between scenes of escape and success over a smooth sample.

description.ja: Sminoが歌とラップの境界を滑り、細かなリズムの切り替えで関係の距離を描く。
description.en: Smino slides between singing and rap, using fine rhythmic shifts to describe distance within a relationship.

description.ja: JIDが速度と発音を細かく切り替え、途切れないヴァースで緊張を押し上げる。
description.en: JID switches pace and articulation in tight increments, raising tension through an unbroken verse.

description.ja: EARTHGANGの二人が声色と拍の置き方を交互に変え、上昇感のあるフックへつなぐ。
description.en: EARTHGANG alternate tone and beat placement, connecting their verses to an upward-driving hook.

name: Noname - Diddy Bop feat. Raury & Cam O'bi

description.ja: Nonameが幼少期の記憶を小さな場面として並べ、軽快なプロダクションへ会話のように乗せる。
description.en: Noname arranges childhood memories as small scenes, delivering them conversationally over buoyant production.

description.ja: Sabaが孤立と周囲の声を二部構成で描き、途中で感情とリズムの焦点を切り替える。
description.en: Saba examines isolation and surrounding voices in two parts, shifting emotional and rhythmic focus mid-track.

description.ja: Mick Jenkinsが反復される言葉を別の意味へずらしながら、低い声と明確な間でヴァースを運ぶ。
description.en: Mick Jenkins shifts a repeated phrase into new meanings, carrying the verse with a low register and deliberate pauses.

name: Open Mike Eagle - Brick Body Complex

description.ja: Open Mike Eagleが建物と身体を重ね、取り壊される場所の記憶を一人称の物語にする。
description.en: Open Mike Eagle overlaps building and body, turning the memory of a demolished place into a first-person story.

description.ja: Quelle Chrisが制度と生活の距離を皮肉と会話調で描き、重いドラムへ言葉をずらして置く。
description.en: Quelle Chris uses irony and conversational phrasing to examine the distance between policy and daily life over heavy drums.

description.ja: Kaが家族への感情を簡潔な韻と静かな声で積み上げ、余白の多いビートに記憶を残す。
description.en: Ka builds feeling for family through concise rhyme and a quiet voice, leaving memory in the beat's open spaces.

description.ja: Rome Streetzが連続する内部韻で映像的なラインを押し込み、短い曲尺を密度で満たす。
description.en: Rome Streetz packs visual lines through continuous internal rhyme, filling the short runtime with density.

description.ja: MAVIが自己認識と関係の断片を折り重ね、語尾を次の小節へまたぐフロウでつなぐ。
description.en: MAVI folds fragments of self-perception and relationships together, linking them with lines that spill across bars.

description.ja: AKAI SOLOが短いフレーズと抽象的な像を連ね、ざらついたループに独自の拍感を作る。
description.en: AKAI SOLO strings together clipped phrases and abstract images, creating his own pulse over a grainy loop.

description.ja: Niontayが低く抑えた声でビートの隙間を使い、短いラインを前後へ揺らしながら進める。
description.en: Niontay uses the gaps in the beat with a low, controlled voice, moving short lines back and forth.

description.ja: Veezeが力を抜いた声と遅れ気味のタイミングを使い、短いパンチラインを連続させる。
description.en: Veeze uses a relaxed voice and slightly delayed timing to chain together compact punchlines.

description.ja: Babyface Rayが会計、移動、日常の細部を淡々と並べ、一定の声量でビートを横切る。
description.en: Babyface Ray lists accounting, movement, and daily detail with an even delivery that cuts steadily across the beat.

description.ja: Rio Da Yung OGが具体的な数字と出来事を高速で並べ、ドラムの前へ言葉を押し出す。
description.en: Rio Da Yung OG fires off specific numbers and events at speed, pushing his words ahead of the drums.

description.ja: EST Geeが反撃と警戒を低い声で反復し、最小限のメロディーへ重心を置く。
description.en: EST Gee repeats retaliation and caution in a low register, placing the weight over minimal melody.

description.ja: Young Nudyと21 Savageが乾いたドラム上で短い句を受け渡し、抑えた声の差で緊張を保つ。
description.en: Young Nudy and 21 Savage trade short phrases over dry drums, sustaining tension through their restrained delivery.

description.ja: 03 Greedoが反復するメロディーで依存と関係を重ね、歌声の揺れを曲の中心に置く。
description.en: 03 Greedo layers dependency and relationships through a recurring melody, making the movement in his voice the track's center.

description.ja: Larry Juneが早朝の移動と生活の細部を落ち着いたテンポで並べ、短い合いの手で区切る。
description.en: Larry June lists early-morning movement and daily details at an unhurried pace, dividing them with brief ad-libs.

name: Curren$y & The Alchemist - Scottie Pippens feat. Freddie Gibbs

description.ja: Curren$yとFreddie Gibbsが同じループ上で異なる速度を見せ、長いヴァースを対照させる。
description.en: Curren$y and Freddie Gibbs bring contrasting speeds to the same loop, setting their extended verses against each other.

name: DOM KENNEDY - My Type of Party

description.ja: DOM KENNEDYが反復の多いフックと平熱の語り口で、ロサンゼルスの夜の場面を組み立てる。
description.en: DOM KENNEDY builds a Los Angeles night scene through a repetitive hook and an even, conversational delivery.

name: Nipsey Hussle - Hussle in the House

description.ja: Nipsey HussleがWest Coastの定番フレーズを引用しながら、自身の地域と名前を前面に出す。
description.en: Nipsey Hussle draws on a familiar West Coast phrase while putting his neighborhood and name at the front.

name: Jay Rock - OSOM feat. J. Cole

description.ja: Jay RockとJ. Coleが成功後にも残る不安を二つの視点から描き、重いビート上で緊張を維持する。
description.en: Jay Rock and J. Cole examine anxiety that remains after success from two perspectives, sustaining tension over a heavy beat.

name: Ab-Soul - Terrorist Threats feat. Danny Brown & Jhené Aiko

description.ja: Ab-SoulとDanny Brownが政治、監視、疑念を異なる声色で展開し、Jhené Aikoのフックが区切りを作る。
description.en: Ab-Soul and Danny Brown approach politics, surveillance, and doubt in contrasting voices, divided by Jhené Aiko's hook.

description.ja: ScHoolboy Qが少年期の一日を場面ごとに進め、映像とヴァースを並行させて物語を作る。
description.en: ScHoolboy Q moves through a day from his youth scene by scene, building the story through video and verse in parallel.

description.ja: Meyhem Laurenが硬いドラムへ短い韻を重ね、客演との声の切り替えで曲を押す。
description.en: Meyhem Lauren stacks compact rhymes over hard drums, driving the track through vocal switches with his guest.

description.ja: Wikiがニューヨークの通りと人々を細部まで拾い、息継ぎの少ないヴァースで地域を描く。
description.en: Wiki picks up street-level details and people across New York, mapping the city through a breathless verse.

description.ja: RATKINGがノイズ、低音、速度の変化をぶつけ、三人の声を都市の断片として配置する。
description.en: RATKING collide noise, bass, and tempo changes, placing three voices as fragments of the city.

description.ja: Flatbush Zombiesの三人がサイケデリックな背景の上でヴァースを受け渡し、低いフックへ戻る。
description.en: The three members of Flatbush Zombies pass verses over a psychedelic backdrop before returning to a low-slung hook.

description.ja: The Underachieversが高速の掛け合いと反復フックを組み合わせ、二人のフロウを連続させる。
description.en: The Underachievers combine rapid exchanges with a repeated hook, keeping both rappers' flows in continuous motion.

description.ja: Capital STEEZが社会構造と精神の自由を結びつけ、長いラインを明確な発音で積み上げる。
description.en: Capital STEEZ connects social structures with mental freedom, building long lines through clear articulation.

name: Max B - Where Do I Go

description.ja: Max Bが歌うようなフロウで迷いと移動を反復し、ラップとメロディーを一続きにする。
description.en: Max B repeats uncertainty and movement through a sung flow, joining rap and melody into one continuous line.

description.ja: Cam'ronが名前を反復するフックと独特の言葉選びで、低くうねるプロダクションを支配する。
description.en: Cam'ron controls the low-slung production with a name-repeating hook and his distinctive word choices.

name: The Diplomats - I Really Mean It

description.ja: The Diplomatsが荘厳なサンプル上で忠誠と確信を言葉にし、反復フックで曲を固定する。
description.en: The Diplomats put loyalty and conviction into words over a grand sample, anchoring the track with a repeated hook.

description.ja: Smif-N-WessunがBrooklynの地域名をフックに据え、二人の低い声を重いドラムへ交互に置く。
description.en: Smif-N-Wessun center a Brooklyn neighborhood in the hook, alternating their low voices over heavy drums.

description.ja: O.G.C.の三人が不安を拒むフックを共有し、低音の強いビート上でヴァースを回す。
description.en: O.G.C.'s three members share a hook rejecting fear, rotating verses over bass-heavy production.

description.ja: Heltah SkeltahとO.G.C.が五人の声を次々に切り替え、反復フックへ勢いを集める。
description.en: Heltah Skeltah and O.G.C. cycle through five voices, gathering momentum into the repeated hook.

description.ja: The Rootsが業界の型を皮肉り、バンド演奏と抑えたラップで模倣と実像の差を描く。
description.en: The Roots satirize industry formulas, using live-band playing and restrained rap to contrast imitation with reality.

description.ja: Oddiseeが制作と移動をめぐる自己点検を明瞭なフロウで進め、自身のビートへ言葉を細かく合わせる。
description.en: Oddisee works through self-assessment around making music and staying in motion, fitting a clear flow tightly to his own production.

description.ja: Commonがラップへの姿勢と観察を整理し、DJ PremierのドラムとBilalのフックに接続する。
description.en: Common organizes his observations and approach to rap, connecting them to DJ Premier's drums and Bilal's hook.

description.ja: Slum VillageがJ Dillaの跳ねるビート上で関係の始まりと距離を簡潔なヴァースにする。

description.ja: 重いベースの上で日本語と英語を切り替え、仕事量と生存感覚を低い声で押し出す。
description.en: Over heavy bass, JIN DOGG switches between Japanese and English, pushing work ethic and survival instinct through a low, forceful delivery.

description.ja: メロディを帯びたフロウと率直な言葉を重ね、現実の手触りを軽やかなテンポへ落とし込む。
description.en: A melodic flow and direct writing turn everyday reality into a light, forward-moving groove.

description.ja: 跳ねる低音に鋭いフロウを乗せ、短いフレーズを連打しながら緊張感を途切れさせない。
description.en: MFS rides bouncing low end with a sharp flow, repeating compact phrases without letting the tension drop.

description.ja: 弾むファンクの感触と自在に形を変える声を組み合わせ、ラップと歌の境界を滑らかに行き来する。
description.en: Smino pairs a springy funk feel with a shape-shifting voice, gliding smoothly between rap and melody.

name: Maxo Kream & Tyler, The Creator - Big Persona

description.ja: Maxo Kreamの重量感ある語り口とTyler, The Creatorの跳ねたフロウが、派手なシンセの上でぶつかり合う。
description.en: Maxo Kream’s heavy storytelling delivery collides with Tyler, The Creator’s elastic flow over bright, oversized synths.

description.ja: デトロイトらしい乾いたビートに、Babyface Rayの抑えた語り口と42 Duggの鋭い声が交差する。
description.en: A dry Detroit beat frames Babyface Ray’s restrained delivery and 42 Dugg’s sharper vocal attack.

description.ja: ジャズを含んだビートとUKラップの硬さを二部構成でつなぎ、場面とテンポを鮮やかに切り替える。
description.en: Knucks links jazz-inflected production with the harder edge of UK rap in a two-part switch of scene and tempo.

description.ja: 軽やかなベースラインと余白のあるドラムに、Saintéの力を抜いたフロウが自然に収まる。
description.en: A buoyant bassline and spacious drums leave room for Sainté’s relaxed flow to settle naturally into the pocket.

description.ja: 抑えきれない苛立ちと脆さを一続きの言葉に変え、内省的な語りを強い推進力へ変える。
description.en: Loyle Carner turns anger and vulnerability into an unbroken stream of words, giving introspection a forceful momentum.

description.ja: 乾いたビートの隙間を短く切るフランス語のフロウで埋め、冷静さを保ったまま圧を高めていく。
description.en: La Fève fills the gaps of a dry beat with clipped French phrasing, building pressure without losing composure.

description.ja: 失業と空腹をめぐる言葉遊びを細かく刻み、Cat Solen監督の奇妙な料理世界が笑いと不穏さを同時に膨らませる。
description.en: Tierra Whack chops wordplay about unemployment and hunger into tight bursts, while Cat Solen’s strange kitchen world pushes the humor toward unease.

description.ja: 故障したシボレーでCentralに足止めされ、Blue LineやSouth Centralの景色を眺めながら、今の生活を抜け出す日を願う。
description.en: Stranded on Central in a broken Chevrolet, Buddy looks past the Blue Line and South Central streets toward the day he can move beyond them.

description.ja: GZA「Liquid Swords」の引用を軸に、女性MCの系譜とIbtihaj Muhammadの存在を重ね、ブラック・ムスリム女性への敬意を刻む。
description.en: Built around GZA’s “Liquid Swords,” Rapsody links a lineage of women MCs with Ibtihaj Muhammad and centers Black Muslim women in the frame.

description.ja: 食事にも困る状態から金を掴む瞬間までを、焦りと高揚が入れ替わるフロウで一気に駆け抜ける。
description.en: Kenny Mason races from scraping for a meal to finally touching money, switching between desperation and disbelief as the moment lands.

description.ja: 南部で育った黒人少女の不安、母を誇らせたい願い、進学後の迷いをたどり、自分の夢を引き受けて前へ進む。
description.en: CHIKA traces a Black Southern girl’s insecurity, her wish to make her mother proud, and the uncertainty of college before choosing to own her dream.

description.ja: Stones Taroのパンチの強いビートを軸に、MFSが自己紹介より先に自分の自由と生き方をまっすぐ押し出す。
description.en: Over Stones Taro’s punchy production, MFS skips the formal introduction and puts her freedom and way of living directly at the center.
